sources.title: OIML R 76-1:2006 Annex G — Additional examinations and tests for software-controlled instruments
WELMEC Guide 7.2:2022 Software Guide (EU Measuring Instruments Directive 2014/32/EU)
OIML D 31:2008 General requirements for software controlled measuring instruments

extraction_note: WELMEC 7.2 defines six risk classes A to F with increasing risk assumptions; risk classes B to D cover all instrument classes falling under the MID. Each measuring instrument is assigned to a risk class because the applicable software requirements are governed by it. Requirements are organised as a basic type (P for a built-for-purpose measuring instrument, U for an instrument using a universal computer) plus extensions selected by the instrument's features.

risk_classes.note: Risk classes B to D cover all instrument classes regulated by the MID. Class A is the lowest and E/F the highest.
risk_classes.nawi_note: The applicable class for a non-automatic weighing instrument is taken from the instrument-specific extension; record the class determined for this model and the justification.

P.label: Type P — built-for-purpose measuring instrument
P.description: An instrument with an embedded, dedicated computing environment.

U.label: Type U — instrument using a universal computer
U.description: An instrument whose legally relevant software runs on a general-purpose computer. Requirements are generally more demanding because the environment is more exposed.

extensions.T: Transmission of measurement data via communication networks
extensions.S: Software separation (legally relevant software separated from other parts)
extensions.I: Instrument-specific extension, which also fixes the applicable risk class

P.title: Protection against accidental or unintentional changes
Software authenticity and presentation of results

U.title: Protection against accidental or unintentional changes
Software authenticity and presentation of results

L.title: Protection against accidental or unintentional changes
Authenticity and traceability of stored measurement data

T.title: Protection against accidental or unintentional changes
Authenticity and traceability of transmitted data
Handling of interrupted or delayed transmission

S.title: Realisation of software separation
S.detail: Legally relevant software and parameters clearly separated from other parts.

S.title: Mixed indication
S.detail: Results shown on a display or printout so that confusion with other information is not possible.

S.title: Protective software interface
S.detail: Communication with the legally relevant software carried out exclusively via a protective software interface.

D.title: Download mechanism
D.detail: Subsequent installation of legally relevant software runs automatically and does not require user interaction that could compromise it.

D.title: Traceability of downloads
D.detail: Downloads of legally relevant software are adequately traceable within the instrument.

r76_annex_g_items.item: Software identification is displayed or printed on command, or shown at start-up.
The legally relevant software is protected against unauthorised modification, loading or swapping of hardware.
Parameters that fix legally relevant characteristics are secured against unauthorised alteration.
A fault log or audit trail records changes to legally relevant parameters, where required.
The checksum or signature algorithm used to protect the software is stated. CRC16 is an acceptable checksum algorithm.
r76_annex_g_items.clause: OIML D 31 §; referenced by Annex G

r76_annex_g_items.item: Detected faults cause the instrument to be deactivated, or an alarm or error-log record to be generated.
Sealing, whether physical or electronic, prevents access to legally relevant software and parameters.

record_fields.label: Checksum or signature value as displayed
How the identification is made available

verdict_rule.rule: Each applicable requirement is recorded as Complies, Does not comply, or Not applicable, with a remark. The software examination passes only when no applicable requirement is marked Does not comply.
